headline: On November 24, 1974: Lucy discovered in Ethiopia
instagramCaption:
Lucy changed everything.

Donald Johanson and Tom Gray found a 40% complete Australopithecus afarensis skeleton in the Afar Depression of Ethiopia. The fossil was nicknamed 'Lucy' after The Beatles song playing at camp that night. It is one of the most complete early hominin skeletons ever found.

Its discovery reshaped understanding of human evolution, showing bipedalism preceded brain expansion.

What do you think made Lucy so revolutionary?
